thesis: Regime unchanged: HBM/memory remains the binding constraint (MU +161.3%, KV-cache offload demand exploding, Huawei HBM bottleneck confirmed). Power is the secondary bottleneck as GW-scale clusters (xAI Colossus 2, Meta multi-GW, Oracle $455B RPO) strain grid capacity. Nvidia's Rubin CPX widens the competitive moat canyon-wide, resetting AMD/ASIC roadmaps again. Platform bifurcation intensifies: AI
